question: Who among the following has been ranked as the richest person in the world, as per the Forbes’ Real-Time Billionaires list 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Elon Musk.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elon Musk** has been ranked as the richest person in the world, as per the **Forbes’ Real-Time Billionaires list 2022.**
 
• According to Forbes' "Real-Time Billionaires List" featuring the richest persons around the world,** Mukesh Ambani **features in the sixth spot, while Gautam Adani occupies the seventh spot.
 
• Mukesh Ambani has a net worth of $103.1 billion, according to Forbes' "Real-Time Billionaires List". 
 
• The Bloomberg Billionaires Index shows Ambani has a net worth of $101 billion.
 
• Mukesh Ambani and Gautam Adani are the richest men in India as well as Asia.
 
• In the "Bloomberg Billionaires Index", Mukesh Ambani is in the eighth spot, and Gautam Adani is in the ninth position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Elon Musk** is an Entrepreneur, Investor, and technocrat. He is the founder, CEO, chief engineer/designer of SpaceX. 
 
• **Jeff Bezos **is the Founder and CEO of Amazon.com.
 
 
• Jeff Bezos-owned Blue Origin will develop a commercial space station called "Orbital Reef" with Boei.
 
 
 
• **Bernard Jean Étienne Arnault** is a French business magnate, investor, and art collector. He is the founder, chairman, and chief executive officer of LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton, the world's largest luxury goods company.
 
• **Warren Edward Buffett** is an American business magnate, investor, and philanthropist. He is currently the chairman and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway.
